name: agent-merge-audit
description: agent-merge-audit inside Claude Code: which merges into your main branch an AI agent wrote or co-wrote, whether a person other than its authors approved each one, who merged it, and the SOC 2 CC8.1 exceptions an auditor asks about, as a dated CSV and markdown pair. Open source, no account, GETs to GitHub's API only. Not audit advice.

plugins.name: agent-merge-audit
plugins.description: List a period's merges with who or what wrote them and who approved them. /agent-merge-audit:agent-merge-audit runs `npx --allow-git=root github:agentwares/agent-merge-audit` on owner/repo and explains each exception and the question an auditor would ask about it.
